_comment: Perceptual-hash signatures of image-host 'this image was removed' placeholder cards. These fixed placeholders return HTTP 200 + an image content-type, so a naive fetch treats them as real art. A fetched image matching a signature here is classified DEAD (reason 'tombstone'), never entered into the manifest. This file is GENERIC reference data (host placeholders are the same for everyone), not account-derived, so it is committed. hash_bits must match the archive index (data/archive_index.db, 64-bit pHash). Add new hosts with: python tombstones.py add <url-or-file> --label <name> --host <host>.

signatures.label: imgur-removed
signatures.note: imgur 'image does not exist' placeholder (503-byte 161x81 image/png). Served with HTTP 200 for a deleted i.imgur.com image.
